title: carelia conyzoides
intro: Carelia conyzoides, commonly known as Carpolobia conyzoides, is a plant species in the family Polygalaceae. It is a climbing shrub native to tropical Africa. The plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, as well as for its use as a local anesthetic and anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of Carelia conyzoides include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
